name: Power Attack
summary: Your strength allows you to amplify the destructive power of your Strikes.
effects: When you make a Melee Attack to Strike with a Weapon (including Improvized but not Unarmed), you can suffer a penalty up to your Body Bonus to make the Damage more Vicious by an equal amount.

name: Greater Resistance
summary: While unable to prevent harm, the refinement of Body can resist it.
effects: You may add your Body Bonus to your Injury Risk. If this rolls outside the range of the Table (13 or more) you avoid all effects.

name: Indomitable
summary: At the apex of physical achievement, only the greatest of peril can wear you down.
effects: You gain Resistence to all Physical Damage, up to your Body Bonus.

name: Wits
summary: Knowing yourself, you might heighten the magnitude of your victories.
effects: The range of natural roll you need to Critically Succeed is increased by your Ability Bonus; this allows you to Critically Succeed on a natural 11, 10, and so on as your Bonus grows.

name: Cunning
summary: Knowing the world, even certain failures can be reversed.
effects: When you fail a Skill Test but not by more than your Ability Bonus, you can suffer 1 Strain and succeed instead. This can also be applied to Preemption rolls, as if they were Skill Tests.

name: Prediction
summary: Knowing the Other, each exchange is riddle; its solution gives way to your uncontested superiority.
effects:
When you Preempt a Creature, you can Critically Succeed if your roll exceeds their Initiative and the natural roll is a 12(adjusted by your Wits). Critical Successes confer the following benefits:
If you Preempted the Target just after they declare an Action, you gain AP equal to the amount they intended to spend.
The Target becomes more Vulnerable to you, equal to your Ability Bonus.

name: Unnatural Agility
summary: You are almost never off your guard, replete with Reflex, each step lighter than the last.
effects: Each Turn, you gain Agility up to your Ability Bonus. Agility can be spent like AP, but only for Reactions. You also gain half as much when rolling Initiative, rounded down.

name: Dodge
summary: The wind shifts, and you as well.
effects: When you are the Target of an Attack, you can spend AP as a Reaction, up to your Ability Bonus, to inflict that many Banes on the Test.

summary: Few, if any, match your pace anymore.
effects: You can spend two Agility to gain one AP at any time.
